investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Eval Failing: POST /api/agents Returns 409 Agent Quota Exceeded (limit is 100)
investigation.summary: The observability eval for remote-agent-create (and both sibling checks remote-agent-state and remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T00:10:03Z because POST /api/agents returned HTTP 409 with the error "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". The eval probe never received a successful agent creation response, so all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are absent and no contract assertions could be evaluated.
investigation.rootCause: The production-api swarm backend rejected the eval's agent creation request with a hard quota conflict: the org used by the observability probe has reached or exceeded the 100-agent limit enforced by the swarm service. Because the creation call fails immediately with a 409, the runner (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1317: createAgent(args, track, "remote", null, orgId)) never obtains an agentId or VM assignment, leaving all required evidence unpopulated. This is a backend quota/state condition localized to the POST /api/agents endpoint for the probe org, not a code defect in the eval runner itself. No evidence of a user-traffic or production incident is present in the packet; this is an eval infrastructure failure against the production API.

possibleCauses: [Highest confidence] The observability probe org has accumulated 100 or more remote agents in the swarm backend (possibly from prior eval runs that did not clean up), causing every new POST /api/agents to be rejected with a quota conflict. The withCleanup wrapper in the runner (run-status-probes.mjs line 1315) is intended to delete agents after each run, but if cleanup failed in a previous run the quota would grow unbounded.
[Medium confidence] A previous eval run crashed or was interrupted before withCleanup could execute, leaving orphaned remote agents in the probe org and incrementally consuming quota across runs.

[Low confidence] The quota limit of 100 was recently lowered on the swarm backend for the probe org, causing previously-passing runs to now hit the cap. No history data is available (previousRunCount: 0, lastPassingAt: null) to confirm or deny a regression from a passing state.

[Low confidence — hypothesis only, not proven] Commit e7b1227 ('fix(observability): read desktop shares from api origin') touched all three implicated eval files (features.json, check-expectations.json, run-status-probes.mjs) approximately 21 minutes before the failing run. However, e7b1227's confirmed touched paths are CI/workflow files with no candidate paths matching remote-agent logic, and its subject concerns desktop shares, not remote agents. This commit is not supported as causal by the available eval or source evidence.
